name: jwangkun/claude-for-financial-services-cn
description: A large collection of skills and plugins for Chinese financial services, covering A-share markets, investment banking, private equity, wealth management, and fund administration, including Wind MCP data skills. Note: Requires user-supplied API credentials for external data access.
install: claude plugin marketplace add jwangkun/claude-for-financial-services-cn, then per plugin claude plugin install china-finance@claude-for-financial-services-cn (and investment-banking, private-equity, wealth-management, fund-admin variants)
